"'''CeeCee'''" was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] with the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]]. She was stationed aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] as of [[41 ABY]], during the last days of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
"CeeCee" was one of the contingent of [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] officers that was stationed aboard the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Darth Caedus]] during the [[Battle of Uroro Station]]. When [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] boarded the vessel in order to kill her brother, she took CeeCee prisoner, exchanging uniforms with her so as to pose as the GAG captain while infiltrating the ship's prison, looking for [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]]. After making it into the ''Anakin Solo''{{'s}} infirmary, Jaina encountered the wounded [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mirta Gev]], who asked for a blaster in order to keep CeeCee and a pair of GAG enlistees "quiet".

As soon as Jaina left the room, however, Gev shot CeeCee and two GAG guards also being held captive.

==Behind the scenes==
"CeeCee"'s informal name is derived from the first and middle initials of her name tag. Her true name is never given.
